find: if (ev !== av) changes.push({ selector, field: `aria.${name}`, expected: ev, actual: av });
replace: if ((ev ?? '') !== (av ?? '')) changes.push({ selector, field: `aria.${name}`, expected: ev, actual: av });
killedBy: the screen baseline: role and aria attributes are compared exactly (issue #937) tells an empty attribute from an absent one
why: Treats an empty attribute and a missing one as the same. aria-label="" is a real, and usually wrong, accessible name -- it can blank a control that has visible text -- while no aria-label falls back to the content. ui.ts removes aria-describedby rather than emptying it for exactly this reason, so a screen that started writing an empty attribute instead must fail the check.
